events.label: Josh Guenser’s Dutch Bros CFO profile

slots.name: CFO
slots.sentence: In his role as CFO of Dutch Bros, the fast-growing coffee chain, Josh Guenser is drawing on what he learned in his previous finance roles at both a midsize company and a national goliath.

slots.name: start date
slots.sentence: Before joining Dutch Bros in 2024, Guenser served as CFO of Mod Pizza, a privately held pizza chain.

slots.name: previous roles
slots.sentence: And in the decade prior, he held various finance and accounting roles at Starbucks, including as senior vice president of finance in the Americas.
